# NDWS tabular results (generated by `python -m src.aml.evaluate`)

All numbers are on the held-out **test** split; thresholds for F1 / precision / recall were chosen on the validation split. PR-AUC 95% CIs come from a patch-level bootstrap (500 resamples). Lift = PR-AUC / test positive rate (chance level = 1x). Positive rates differ across protocols, so compare protocols with Lift and ROC-AUC, not raw PR-AUC. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script.

| Persistence | 0.107 [0.097, 0.118] | 8.5x | 0.633 | 0.309 | 0.357 | 0.273 | 0.276 | 0.305 | 0.0153 |
| Neighbourhood persistence | 0.173 [0.157, 0.191] | 13.8x | 0.729 | 0.328 | 0.251 | 0.473 | 0.360 | 0.491 | 0.0121 |
